```{python}
#| include: false

from pathlib import Path
import importlib
import logging
import os
import re

import sys

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update(
    {
        "figure.dpi": 300,
        "savefig.dpi": 300,
        "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    }
)

PROJECT_DIR = Path.cwd().resolve()
if PROJECT_DIR.name == "load":
    PROJECT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR.parent
LOAD_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "load"
DATA_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "data"
sys.path.insert(0, str(LOAD_DIR))

import ascot_update_loader as ascot
ascot = importlib.reload(ascot)

ascot.configure_logging()
refresh_cache = os.getenv("ASCOT_REFRESH_CACHE", "0").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "y"}
print(f"[Ascot] Starting report setup (refresh_cache={refresh_cache}).", flush=True)
print("[Ascot] Loading database sources...", flush=True)
raw_sources = ascot.load_database_sources(LOAD_DIR, DATA_DIR, refresh=refresh_cache)
print("[Ascot] Preparing database sources...", flush=True)
sources = ascot.prepare_sources(raw_sources)
print("[Ascot] Source loading complete.", flush=True)

df_sre = sources["stick_readings"]
df_gre = sources["going_reports"]
calendar_database = sources["calendar_database"]
going_groups = sources["going_groups"]
map_waypoints = sources["map_waypoints"]
maps = sources["maps"]

ASCOT = "Ascot"
df_sre = df_sre.loc[df_sre["course"].eq(ASCOT)].copy()
df_gre = df_gre.loc[df_gre["course"].eq(ASCOT)].copy()
calendar_database = calendar_database.loc[calendar_database["course"].eq(ASCOT)].copy()
going_groups = going_groups.loc[going_groups["course"].eq(ASCOT)].copy()
map_waypoints = map_waypoints.loc[map_waypoints["course"].eq(ASCOT)].copy()
maps = maps.loc[maps["course"].eq(ASCOT)].copy()

calendar_reconciliation = calendar_database.copy()
waypoint_compliance, _ = ascot.map_waypoint_compliance(
    df_gre,
    df_sre,
    map_waypoints,
)
observations = ascot.going_compliance_observations(
    calendar_reconciliation,
    df_gre,
    df_sre,
    going_groups,
    waypoint_compliance,
)

chart_cutoff_date = pd.Timestamp.today().normalize()
chart_observations = observations.loc[
    observations["meeting_date"].le(chart_cutoff_date)
].copy()
chart_observations["reporting_category"] = chart_observations[
    "reporting_category"
].replace(
    {
        "data uploaded - Going matches": "data uploaded",
        "data uploaded - mismatch or review": "data uploaded",
    }
)

declaration = chart_observations.loc[
    chart_observations["observation_window"].eq("declaration_day"),
    ["meeting_date", "course", "is_abandoned", "reporting_category"],
]
race_day = chart_observations.loc[
    chart_observations["observation_window"].eq("race_day"),
    ["meeting_date", "course", "is_abandoned", "reporting_category"],
]
combined = declaration.merge(
    race_day,
    on=["meeting_date", "course"],
    suffixes=("_declaration", "_race_day"),
)
combined["year"] = combined["meeting_date"].dt.year
combined["combined_reporting_category"] = "going value not reported"

both_have_going = (
    combined["reporting_category_declaration"].ne("going value not reported")
    & combined["reporting_category_race_day"].ne("going value not reported")
)
both_uploaded = (
    combined["reporting_category_declaration"].eq("data uploaded")
    & combined["reporting_category_race_day"].eq("data uploaded")
)
combined.loc[both_have_going, "combined_reporting_category"] = (
    "going value reported"
)
combined.loc[both_uploaded, "combined_reporting_category"] = "data uploaded"
combined.loc[
    combined["is_abandoned_declaration"] | combined["is_abandoned_race_day"],
    "combined_reporting_category",
] = "abandoned"

category_order = [
    "abandoned",
    "data uploaded",
    "going value reported",
    "going value not reported",
]
category_colors = ["#d62728", "#2ca02c", "#ff7f0e", "#1f77b4"]
combined_percentages = (
    combined.groupby(["year", "combined_reporting_category"])
    .size()
    .unstack(fill_value=0)
    .reindex(columns=category_order, fill_value=0)
)
combined_percentages = combined_percentages.div(
    combined_percentages.sum(axis=1), axis=0
).fillna(0) * 100
```

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5, 5.8))
combined_percentages.plot(
    kind="bar",
    stacked=True,
    width=0.82,
    color=category_colors,
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set_title("Combined Declaration and Race Day Reporting by Year", fontsize=18)

ax.set_ylabel("Race meetings (%)")

ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=0)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
ax.legend(
    title="Reporting status",
    loc="upper center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.14),
    ncol=4,
    frameon=False,
)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# GoingStick Data&#10;Stats

## Index Values by Year

```{python}
#| fig-width: 12.5
#| fig-height: 5.0
#| fig-align: center

map_race_type = maps[["map_id", "map_label", "goings_group_id"]].drop_duplicates("map_id").assign(
    race_type=lambda dataframe: dataframe["map_label"].astype("string").str.casefold().eq("jump").map(
        {True: "Jump", False: "Flat"}
    )
)

api_reports = df_gre.loc[
    df_gre["stick_user"].astype("string").str.strip().str.casefold()
    .eq("apiuser.bhagoing@turftrax.co.uk")
    & df_gre["official_going"].astype("string").fillna("").str.strip().ne("")
].copy()
api_reports["meeting_date"] = pd.to_datetime(
    api_reports["race_date"], errors="coerce"
).dt.normalize()
api_reports["report_timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(
    api_reports["make_date"], errors="coerce"
).fillna(pd.to_datetime(api_reports["created_at_gr"], errors="coerce"))
api_reports = (
    api_reports.sort_values("report_timestamp")
    .drop_duplicates(["meeting_date", "course", "map_id"], keep="last")
    [["meeting_date", "course", "map_id", "official_going"]]
    .rename(columns={"official_going": "api_official_going"})
)

direct_official = (
    df_gre.loc[
        df_gre["official_going"].astype("string").fillna("").str.strip().ne(""),
        ["gr_id", "official_going"],
    ]
    .drop_duplicates("gr_id")
    .rename(columns={"official_going": "direct_official_going"})
)
report_dates = df_gre[["gr_id", "course", "make_date", "created_at_gr"]].drop_duplicates(
    "gr_id"
).copy()
report_dates["report_date"] = pd.to_datetime(
    report_dates["make_date"], errors="coerce"
).fillna(pd.to_datetime(report_dates["created_at_gr"], errors="coerce")).dt.normalize()
meeting_candidates = pd.concat(
    [
        calendar_database[["meeting_date", "course"]].assign(
            report_date=calendar_database["meeting_date"], candidate_priority=0
        ),
        calendar_database[["meeting_date", "course"]].assign(
            report_date=calendar_database["meeting_date"] - pd.Timedelta(days=2),
            candidate_priority=1,
        ),
        calendar_database[["meeting_date", "course"]].assign(
            report_date=calendar_database["meeting_date"] - pd.Timedelta(days=3),
            candidate_priority=2,
        ),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)
report_meeting_keys = (
    report_dates.merge(meeting_candidates, on=["course", "report_date"], how="inner")
    .sort_values(["gr_id", "candidate_priority", "meeting_date"])
    .drop_duplicates("gr_id")
    [["gr_id", "meeting_date"]]
)

index_boxplot_data = (
    df_sre.loc[
        df_sre["data_type"].eq("data point")
        & df_sre["date"].dt.year.between(2021, 2026)
        & df_sre["date"].le(pd.Timestamp.today().normalize()),
        ["date", "gr_id", "gr_map_id", "course", "sr_index", "sr_penetration", "sr_shear"],
    ]
    .merge(direct_official, on="gr_id", how="left")
    .merge(report_meeting_keys, on="gr_id", how="left")
    .merge(
        api_reports,
        left_on=["meeting_date", "course", "gr_map_id"],
        right_on=["meeting_date", "course", "map_id"],
        how="left",
    )
    .merge(
        map_race_type[["map_id", "race_type", "goings_group_id"]],
        left_on="gr_map_id",
        right_on="map_id",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_map"),
    )
    .assign(
        official_going=lambda dataframe: dataframe["direct_official_going"].fillna(
            dataframe["api_official_going"]
        )
    )
    .dropna(subset=["course", "sr_index", "race_type", "official_going"])
    .assign(year=lambda dataframe: dataframe["date"].dt.year)
)

# Use only the active Ascot Flat and Jump groups, ordered by their numeric cutoffs.
active_ascot_going_groups = {30, 62}
index_boxplot_data = index_boxplot_data.loc[
    index_boxplot_data["goings_group_id"].isin(active_ascot_going_groups)
].copy()
going_group_bands = going_groups.loc[
    going_groups["goings_group_id"].isin(active_ascot_going_groups)
    & going_groups["going"].notna()
    & going_groups["going_min"].notna()
    & going_groups["going_max"].notna()
    & ~going_groups["going"].astype("string").str.casefold().eq("not in use")
].copy()
going_labels = (
    going_group_bands.assign(label_key=lambda dataframe: dataframe["going"].str.casefold())
    .drop_duplicates("label_key")
    .set_index("label_key")["going"]
    .to_dict()
)
label_pattern = re.compile(
    r"(?<!\w)(" + "|".join(
        re.escape(label) for label in sorted(going_labels, key=len, reverse=True)
    ) + r")(?!\w)"
)
index_boxplot_data["official_going_category"] = (
    index_boxplot_data["official_going"]
    .astype("string")
    .str.casefold()
    .str.extract(label_pattern.pattern, expand=False)
    .map(going_labels)
)
going_order = (
    going_group_bands.groupby("going", as_index=False)["going_min"]
    .min()
    .sort_values("going_min")["going"]
    .tolist()
)

race_type_colours = {"Jump": "#1f4e79", "Flat": "#5b9bd5"}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 5.0), sharey=True)
for ax, race_type in zip(axes, ("Jump", "Flat")):
    subset = index_boxplot_data.loc[index_boxplot_data["race_type"].eq(race_type)].copy()
    subset["year"] = pd.Categorical(
        subset["year"], categories=list(range(2021, 2027)), ordered=True
    )
    subset.boxplot(
        column="sr_index",
        by="year",
        ax=ax,
        grid=False,
        patch_artist=True,
        boxprops={"facecolor": race_type_colours[race_type], "alpha": 0.75},
        medianprops={"color": "#202020", "linewidth": 1.5},
    )
    ax.set_title(f"{race_type} racing", fontsize=18)
    ax.set_xlabel("Year")
    ax.set_ylabel("Going Stick index")
    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)

fig.suptitle("")
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Index Values by Official Going

```{python}
#| fig-width: 12.5

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 5.0), sharey=True)
for ax, race_type in zip(axes, ("Jump", "Flat")):
    subset = index_boxplot_data.loc[index_boxplot_data["race_type"].eq(race_type)].copy()
```

## Daily GS Shear

```{python}
#| fig-width: 14.5
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| fig-align: center

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import matplotlib.dates as mdates

daily_shear = (
    index_boxplot_data.dropna(subset=["sr_shear"])
    .assign(year=lambda dataframe: dataframe["date"].dt.year)
    .groupby(["race_type", "year", "date"], observed=True)["sr_shear"]
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
)
start_date = pd.Timestamp("2022-06-01")
end_date = pd.Timestamp("2026-12-31")
flat_colour = "#f28e2b"
jump_colour = "#2f75b5"
line_colour = "#808080"
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14.5, 6.2))
for year in range(2021, 2027):
    year_data = daily_shear.loc[daily_shear["year"].eq(year)].sort_values("date")
    ax.plot(
        year_data["date"],
        year_data["sr_shear"],
        color=line_colour,
        linewidth=1.2,
        alpha=0.8,
    )
    for race_type, dot_colour in (("Flat", flat_colour), ("Jump", jump_colour)):
        points = year_data.loc[year_data["race_type"].eq(race_type)]
        ax.scatter(
            points["date"],
            points["sr_shear"],
            color=dot_colour,
            s=24,
            zorder=3,
        )

ax.set_title("Daily GS Shear by Fixture Type", fontsize=18)
ax.set_xlim(start_date, end_date)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=3))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b\n%Y"))
ax.set_xlabel("Date")
ax.set_ylabel("Mean GS shear")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
legend_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=line_colour, linewidth=1.2, label=str(year))
    for year in range(2021, 2027)
]
legend_handles += [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="none", markerfacecolor=flat_colour,
           markeredgecolor=flat_colour, markersize=6, label="Flat fixture"),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="none", markerfacecolor=jump_colour,
           markeredgecolor=jump_colour, markersize=6, label="Jump fixture"),
]
ax.legend(
    handles=legend_handles,
    title="Year / fixture type",
    loc="center left",
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0.5),
    frameon=False,
)
fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.82, bottom=0.22)
plt.show()
```
